mechanism: Phenelzine is an MAOI with potential for hypertensive crisis and serotonergic effects; dolutegravir has minimal serotonergic activity but requires careful monitoring with MAOIs due to potential CNS and cardiovascular effects.
action: Use combination only if benefits outweigh risks; monitor blood pressure closely, avoid concurrent serotonergic agents, and counsel patient on dietary tyramine restrictions and symptom awareness.
